detection_logic: user_id appears more than once; every repeat is an exact copy of an earlier row (pandas duplicated on all columns).
likely_cause: Record re-inserted by a retried import or append without a key check.
correction: Keep the first occurrence; delete 8 repeats.
prevention: Primary-key uniqueness constraint on user_id at load; idempotent upsert.
example_records: VLUSR000779, VLUSR000335, VLUSR000272, VLUSR000803, VLUSR000217, VLUSR000409

likely_cause: Field not captured or lost during export.
correction: Re-source from system of record; else mark 'unknown' explicitly, never guess.
prevention: NOT NULL / required-field validation at ingestion.

detection_logic: Value does not parse with format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (values: 'N/A', '2026-14-02 12:00').
likely_cause: Free-text placeholder ('N/A') and a day/month swap or typo ('2026-14-02 12:00').
correction: Quarantine rows; recover true timestamp from backend logs.
prevention: Typed timestamp column; reject non-ISO strings at ingestion.

detection_logic: days_since_registration differs from (2026-09-15 00:00 - registration_datetime) by more than rounding (0.06 day).
likely_cause: Registration timestamp edited after the derived column was computed, or derived column stale.
correction: Treat registration_datetime from the system of record as truth; recompute derived fields in the transformation layer.
prevention: Do not store derived columns in source tables; compute them downstream with a documented reference date.

detection_logic: last_login_datetime blank for a user who is not 'Pending Verification' (all 72 pending users are blank by design).
likely_cause: Login timestamp not written for this account.
correction: Re-source from auth logs.
prevention: Conditional-required rule: last_login required when lifetime_sessions > 0 and status != pending_verification.

detection_logic: active_days = 0 while lifetime_sessions > 0 (a session implies at least one active day).
likely_cause: Counters maintained separately and not reconciled, or active_days defined differently (undocumented).
correction: Recompute both counters from session/event history.
prevention: Derive counters from events in the analytics layer; add cross-field rule.
example_records: VLUSR000004, VLUSR000018, VLUSR000023, VLUSR000043, VLUSR000052, VLUSR000069

detection_logic: A last login exists but lifetime_sessions = 0.
likely_cause: Session counter not incremented on login.
correction: Recompute from login events.
prevention: Single source for sessions (sessions table).
example_records: VLUSR000016, VLUSR000027, VLUSR000119, VLUSR000177, VLUSR000197, VLUSR000236

detection_logic: lifetime_sessions > 0 but no last login (all are 'Pending Verification').
likely_cause: Sessions may be counted before verification without a login record, or counter is wrong; definition of 'session' unclear.
correction: Clarify whether unverified users can hold sessions (A-008).
prevention: Document session definition; derive from session table.
example_records: VLUSR000010, VLUSR000014, VLUSR000015, VLUSR000034, VLUSR000042, VLUSR000047

detection_logic: marketing_opt_in = Yes while consent_status = Pending.
likely_cause: Opt-in captured independently of consent.
correction: Treat these users as not opted in until consent is accepted.
prevention: Rule: marketing_opt_in may be true only if consent_status = accepted.
example_records: VLUSR000040, VLUSR000047, VLUSR000105, VLUSR000144, VLUSR000152, VLUSR000228

detection_logic: days_since_registration < 0, violating the supplied dictionary rule '>=0'.
likely_cause: Derived with reference date 2026-09-15 00:00 while registrations continue later that day.
correction: Recompute with a documented reference timestamp at the end of the period.
prevention: Compute derived fields downstream with an explicit as-of timestamp.

detection_logic: last_login_datetime after the stated dataset period end (15 Sep 2026).
likely_cause: Snapshot taken later than stated period, or timestamps in a different timezone.
correction: Confirm extraction time and timezone (A-004).
prevention: Store extraction timestamp and timezone with every dataset.

detection_logic: Flags reproduce exactly only with reference date 2026-09-15 00:00 on login time (0 mismatches); users whose last login is after that moment are still counted active.
likely_cause: Reference date and definition (login-based) not documented.
correction: Document as-of timestamp; re-define activity on qualifying events (K-USR-02).
prevention: Derived flags carry definition + as-of metadata.
example_records: VLUSR000106, VLUSR000128, VLUSR000261, VLUSR000267, VLUSR000359, VLUSR000376

detection_logic: Account 'Active' while email verification is 'Pending'.
likely_cause: May be valid (e.g. verification not required to use the platform).
correction: None until rule confirmed (A-009).
prevention: Document the rule.
example_records: VLUSR000006, VLUSR000056, VLUSR000077, VLUSR000083, VLUSR000103, VLUSR000137

detection_logic: platform = 'Web' for 100% of users while primary_device includes Android and iOS.
likely_cause: platform means 'web app' and device means OS; not documented.
correction: Rename to signup_platform and device_os/device_type.
prevention: Dictionary definitions with allowed values.

detection_logic: Direct identifiers and sensitive attributes present in an analytics dataset.
likely_cause: Dataset built from an account export rather than an analytics model.
correction: Remove from analytics layer; keep in identity store only; use age_band if needed.
prevention: Pseudonymous analytics model (deliverable 17).

detection_logic: Columns present in the user sheets but missing from the supplied Data_Dictionary sheet.
likely_cause: Dictionary not updated when columns added.
correction: Add both fields.
prevention: Validator: every column must have a dictionary entry (scripts/validate.py does this for this project).

detection_logic: Users_1000_Clean has no data_environment column (the audit sheet has one).
likely_cause: Label added to one sheet only.
correction: Add label column to every sheet.
prevention: Pipeline adds data_environment on load.

detection_logic: record_id not unique.
likely_cause: ID generated by copying or by a non-unique sequence.
correction: Re-key affected rows from source; keep both until source confirms.
prevention: Unique constraint; server-generated IDs.

detection_logic: user_id blank.
likely_cause: Event emitted before user context set.
correction: Recover from session or reference record; else exclude from user KPIs.
prevention: Reject events without user_id at collection.
example_records: VLMSY00090, VLMSY00158, VLMSY00215, VLMSY00395, VLMSY00442, VLMSY00453

detection_logic: event_timestamp_utc blank.
likely_cause: Producer did not set time.
correction: Use received_at_utc only if documented; else quarantine.
prevention: Required timestamp at producer + collection.

detection_logic: Not ISO 8601 UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) or not a real calendar date/time.
likely_cause: Mixed formats from different producers; manual edits.
correction: Parse known formats with explicit rules; quarantine the rest.
prevention: Single timestamp format enforced by SDK and schema.
example_records: VLMSY00058, VLMSY00182, VLMSY00243, VLMSY00361, VLMSY00431, VLMSY00473

detection_logic: status (case-insensitive) not in the allowed list for the source table.
likely_cause: Free-text statuses from manual processes or partner systems.
correction: Map to approved values only where meaning is certain; else quarantine.
prevention: Enum validation against approved values.
example_records: VLMSY00020, VLMSY00046, VLMSY00137, VLMSY00375, VLMSY00379, VLMSY00415

detection_logic: status valid only after lower-casing.
likely_cause: No canonical casing.
correction: Lower-case in transformation.
prevention: Enum validation is case-sensitive.
example_records: VLMSY00045, VLMSY00206, VLMSY00217, VLMSY00275, VLMSY00328, VLMSY00345

detection_logic: Leading/trailing whitespace in any text field.
likely_cause: Manual entry or string concatenation.
correction: Trim in transformation.
prevention: Trim at collection; schema regex.
example_records: VLMSY00010, VLMSY00232, VLMSY00285, VLMSY00295, VLMSY00333, VLMSY00341

detection_logic: amount not parseable as a number.
likely_cause: Text in numeric field (units, typos, spreadsheet errors).
correction: Recover from source; never coerce silently.
prevention: Numeric type at schema level.
example_records: VLMSY00024, VLMSY00075, VLMSY00186, VLMSY00230, VLMSY00235, VLMSY00364

detection_logic: amount < 0 (amounts are absolute; direction is separate).
likely_cause: Sign used instead of direction field.
correction: Use abs(amount) only if direction confirms; else quarantine.
prevention: amount > 0 rule; direction enum.

detection_logic: payout_method blank on a withdrawal record.
likely_cause: Field dropped in export.
correction: Re-source from withdrawals table.
prevention: Conditional-required rule.

detection_logic: user_id not found in Users.

correction: Hold out of KPIs until resolved.
prevention: Referential integrity check at load.
example_records: VLMSY00022, VLMSY00266, VLMSY00335, VLMSY00429, VLMSY00436, VLMSY00445

detection_logic: Identical rows (all fields except record_id).
likely_cause: Producer retry without idempotency key.
correction: Drop later copies.
prevention: event_id generated once and reused on retry; dedup on event_id.
example_records: VLMSY00511, VLMSY00512, VLMSY00513, VLMSY00514, VLMSY00515, VLMSY00516

detection_logic: event_name not snake_case object_action or not in the catalogue.

correction: Map to catalogue names.
prevention: Schema registry rejects unknown names.
example_records: VLMSY00121, VLMSY00132, VLMSY00143, VLMSY00388, VLMSY00452, VLMSY00459

detection_logic: Within one reference_id, a later lifecycle stage is timestamped before an earlier stage (e.g. completed before requested).
likely_cause: Clock issues, back-dated manual edits or out-of-order replay.
correction: Quarantine lifecycle; rebuild from status history.
prevention: State machine enforced in backend; status history append-only.
